svg.title: Сгибание кистей за спиной — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Two rear three-quarter views of standing behind-back BARBELL wrist curl. Both hands hold one straight short bar behind glutes, elbows straight throughout. Start fingers extended slightly and wrists neutral, finish palms curl bar upward toward forearm by bending wrists only. Clear dorsal view of hands and bar. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
